title: 第5章 三件法宝第6章 酒色财气
slug: 大楚第一探花开局卧底女魔头
content_zh:
鱼忠贤眼中闪过一丝异色“你倒是狡猾，这么快就想到了公报私仇的办法。”
“不过他们都是朝廷大员，又岂能轻易处置，你只有完成任务，证明了自己比他们更有价值，我才会权衡利弊，帮你处理掉他们。”
宋牧驰此时已经冷静了下来，他清楚就算舌灿莲花，鱼忠贤也不可能因为几句话就杀了那两位朝廷大员，看来只能另外想办法了。
“既然要让我去完成这么艰巨的任务，是不是该给我一些装备道具，比如神功秘笈或者法宝神兵之类的？”
他如今最缺的就是这两样，虽然先天牛马圣体已经解锁，可九品炼体境突破到八品真阳境的功法都是朝廷严格管制的。
谁知道鱼忠贤直接摇了摇头“功法给了你反而容易引起商玄镜的怀疑，你若是能成功取得信任，富可敌国的她自然可以为你提供这些。”
宋牧驰“……”
都说当间谍是世上最苦逼的差事，敌人靠不住，朋友靠不住，连身后的组织也靠不住，他终于亲身体会到了。
“不过你实力太差，确实需要一点东西帮助。”鱼忠贤递给他一把黯淡无光的匕首，“它名为藏锋，可以吸收主人的杀意来蓄势，你的杀意越浓，温养越久，它爆发出的威力也就越大，这样不至于让你以后面对高阶修士连对方防御都破不开。”
“它使用后会再次变为普通匕首，下次使用前又需要经过漫长的蓄势，所以使用它一定要慎之又慎。”
宋牧驰大喜，这个世界各系的修行者越到高阶，身体强度越大，甚至站在那里让普通人捅也未必能破皮，但有了此物，越级挑战会方便很多。
接着鱼忠贤又递给了他一块玉佩“此物名为含光，能帮你挡下一次致命攻击，但一旦发动，它需要十二个时辰才能恢复，所以别作死。”
“这是隐兰台珍藏之物，除了我无人知晓。你曾经是首辅之子，身上有这样的东西倒也不会引起商玄镜怀疑。”
“多谢鱼大人！”宋牧驰接过玉佩，刚刚说话的声音太大了，组织还是靠得住的。
玉佩仿佛被岁月反复摩挲、光华收敛到极致的旧物，隐约可见中心有一抹天然的淡淡红线，看起来并不名贵，难怪叫含光。
“另外这些日子牢狱生活让你气血亏空得太厉害，”鱼忠贤取出一个锦盒，“这是春秋造化丹，你服下后能修复体内各种暗疾，还能增加苦修十年的气血之力，虽然无法助你突破到八品真阳境，但应该也能让你多一点自保之力。”
宋牧驰接过丹药一口服下，鱼忠贤眼中闪过一丝异色“你就不怕这里面有毒么？”
“就算有毒应该也不会马上致命。”宋牧驰坦然一笑，刚刚【摸鱼】异象让他敏锐注意到对方头顶若隐若现的红光，清楚他已经暗藏杀机。
对方已经跟他说了这么多秘密，甚至还给了他两种珍贵法宝，若是有半点拒绝，恐怕只有被灭口的下场。
所以这丹药有没有毒都不重要，更何况接下来要做的事需要马上提升功力才行。

旋即闭上眼睛开始炼化那枚丹药，只觉得一股热力散至四肢百骸，苍白的脸色肉眼可见的速度红润起来，体内接近枯竭的气血之力也迅速充盈起来，他顿时有一种精力充沛的爆炸感，仿佛能随手打死一头牛。
鱼忠贤赞许地点了点头“你比我想象中的要好很多，说不定你真的能完成这个艰巨的任务。”
“这是隐兰台制定的一个你越狱、接近目标的计划，你认真背下来，有什么需要修改和配合的跟我们说，这些资料会在一炷香后自动销毁。”
“从今以后你在隐兰台的代号是‘蝴蝶’，在楚国这边，你由我单线联系；在燕国，到时候我会派人接应配合你。”
宋牧驰“……”
听着怎么像采花贼的名号。
“我要先确认宋家人的安危。”
“可以，你离开前我会安排你偷偷见他们一眼，不过不能被他们知晓，你应该知道为什么。”鱼忠贤冷冷道。
宋牧驰点了点头，他要执行秘密任务，当然越少人知道他的情况越好。
鱼忠贤走到门口“对了，还有一点必须提醒你，你只有三个月的时间，若是三个月后你还无法完成任务，你和宋家人，只有死路一条。”
“你也别以为在燕国能跑掉，刚刚你吃的那颗春秋造化丹，除了能给人增加十年功力之外，还是一种慢性毒药，若是三个月后没有解药服下，你会求生不得求死不能。”
宋牧驰脸色平静，仿佛早就料到如此“看来我想不完成任务都不行了。”
“祝你成功。”鱼忠贤点了点头，飘然离去。
宋牧驰仔细研究着隐兰台给他设计的作战计划，不得不说隐兰台人才还是不少的，这些计划合情合理，连他如何逃出大牢都有十分充足的理由，后续接近追求商玄镜的计划更是五花八门。
不过他也清楚之前那几位王牌密探为何会横死了。
content_en:
A strange look flashed in Yu Zhongxian's eyes: "You are quite cunning. You have thought of a way to avenge your private revenge so quickly."
"But they are all high officials of the imperial court, so how can they be dealt with easily? Only if you complete the task and prove that you are more valuable than them, will I weigh the pros and cons and help you deal with them."
Song Muchi had calmed down at this time. He knew that even if he had a bright tongue, Yu Zhongxian would not be able to kill the two court officials just because of a few words. It seemed that he could only find another way.
"Since you want me to complete such a difficult task, shouldn't I be given some equipment and props, such as magical secrets or magical weapons?"
These are the two things he lacks most now. Although the innate ox-horse holy body has been unlocked, the techniques for breaking through from the ninth-grade body refining realm to the eighth-grade true sun realm are strictly controlled by the imperial court.
Unexpectedly, Yu Zhongxian shook his head directly, "Giving the skills to you will easily arouse Shang Xuanjing's suspicion. If you can successfully gain trust, she, who is as rich as the enemy, can naturally provide you with these."
Song Muchi "..."
It is said that being a spy is the most difficult job in the world. Your enemies can't be relied on, your friends can't be relied on, and even the organization behind you can't be relied on. He finally experienced it personally.
"But your strength is too weak and you really need some help." Yu Zhongxian handed him a dull dagger. "It's called Zang Feng. It can absorb the master's murderous intention to gain momentum. The stronger your murderous intention is and the longer it is warmed, the more powerful it will be. This will prevent you from being unable to break through the opponent's defense when facing high-level monks in the future."
"After it is used, it will turn into an ordinary dagger again, and it will take a long time to accumulate power before using it next time, so you must be careful when using it."
Song Muchi was overjoyed. The higher the level of practitioners in this world, the stronger their bodies. Even standing there and being poked by ordinary people may not be able to break the skin. But with this thing, it will be much easier to challenge higher levels.
Then Yu Zhongxian handed him another jade pendant: "This object is called Hanguang. It can help you block a fatal attack, but once it is launched, it will take twelve hours to recover, so don't seek death."
"This is a treasure of Yinlantai. No one knows about it except me. You were once the son of the chief minister, so having something like this on you will not arouse Shang Xuanjing's suspicion."
"Thank you, Mr. Yu!" Song Muchi took the jade pendant. He spoke too loudly just now, but the organization is still reliable.
The jade pendant seems to be an old thing that has been repeatedly rubbed by the years and its brilliance has been reduced to the extreme. There is a faint natural red line in the center. It does not look expensive. No wonder it is called Hanguang.
"In addition, these days of prison life have depleted your energy and blood too much," Yu Zhongxian took out a brocade box, "This is the Spring and Autumn Creation Pill. After you take it, it can repair various hidden diseases in the body, and it can also increase the energy and blood power of ten years of hard work. Although it cannot help you break through to the eighth-grade True Yang realm, it should also give you a little more ability to protect yourself."
Song Muchi took the elixir and swallowed it. A strange look flashed in Yu Zhongxian's eyes, "Aren't you afraid that there is poison in it?"
"Even if it's poisonous, it shouldn't be fatal immediately." Song Muchi smiled calmly. The vision of [fishing] just now made him keenly aware of the looming red light above the other party's head, and he knew that he had hidden murderous intentions.
The other party has told him so many secrets, and even gave him two precious magic weapons. If he refuses at all, he may only end up being silenced.
So it doesn't matter whether the elixir is poisonous or not, not to mention that the next thing to do requires improving one's skills immediately.
Immediately he closed his eyes and began to refine the elixir. He felt a heat spread to his limbs and bones. His pale face turned rosy at a speed that was visible to the naked eye. The nearly exhausted energy and blood in his body also quickly filled up. He suddenly felt an explosion of energy, as if he could kill a cow at will.
Yu Zhongxian nodded approvingly, "You are much better than I thought. Maybe you can really complete this task."A difficult task. "
"This is a plan formulated by Yinlantai for you to escape from prison and get closer to your goal. Memorize it carefully and tell us if you need any modifications or cooperation. These data will be automatically destroyed after burning an incense stick. "
"From now on, your codename in Yinlan Terrace is 'Butterfly'. On the Chu State side, you will be contacted by me through a single line; in the Yan State, I will send someone to assist you when the time comes. "
Song Muchi "..."
It sounds like the name of a flower picker.
“I want to confirm the safety of the Song family first. "
"Okay, I will arrange for you to see them secretly before you leave, but you can't let them know. You should know why. "Yu Zhongxian said coldly.
Song Muchi nodded. He wanted to perform a secret mission. Of course, the less people knew about his situation, the better.
Yu Zhongxian walked to the door, "By the way, one more thing I must remind you is that you only have three months. If you still can't complete the task after three months, you and the Song family will only die. "
"Don't think you can run away in the Yan Kingdom. The Spring and Autumn Creation Pill you just took can not only increase a person's skill for ten years, but it is also a chronic poison. If you don't take the antidote after three months, you will be unable to survive. "
Song Muchi's face was calm, as if he had expected this. "It seems that I can't even finish the task. "
"I wish you success. "Yu Zhongxian nodded and left.
Song Muchi carefully studied the battle plan that Yinlantai designed for him. He had to say that Yinlantai had a lot of talents. These plans were reasonable and reasonable. Even how he escaped from the prison had very good reasons. The subsequent plans to pursue Shang Xuanjing were even more diverse.
But he also knew why those ace spies died suddenly.
